summary: Verified seed idempotency and public API regression for Burger Times seed.py rewrite. All 9 backend tests passed: preview DB unchanged (menu=40, categories=9, sauces=12, meats=6, supplements=6, sizes=3, styles=1, cheeses=0); fresh scratch DB seeded produces exact same counts + 1 settings singleton + 1 admin user; running seed twice on scratch DB produces no duplicates. Admin login + /api/admin/menu + /api/checkout/quote + /api/restaurant/status all working.
critical_code_review_comments: seed.py: idempotency logic is clean (match on id/slug, dict(doc) prevents in-place mutation, admin edits preserved).
seed_admin() correctly rehashes when password rotated; verify_password guards no-op path.
seed_settings() backfills missing keys on old DBs, good forward-compat pattern.

seed_data/settings.json is present in the directory but not wired through seed_menu_data — settings still comes from seed_settings() defaults. Not a bug, just an unused file; either wire it or delete to avoid confusion.
burger_cheeses.json is an empty array — _seed_collection early-returns on empty docs so the collection is never created; harmless because count=0 is the desired state, but noted for awareness.
seed_data_creation: Created transient scratch MongoDB db 'seed_verification_<uuid>' during fresh-seed test; dropped in teardown_class.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test file is /app/backend/tests/test_seed_and_apis.py — run with: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_seed_and_apis.py -v. Uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from env. Fresh-seed test drops its own scratch DB after run — never touches test_database. If seed.py changes, re-run to validate idempotency.
rca of the issue: Original bug (menu missing in production) RCA: preview and prod use separate Mongo databases; the old seed.py hardcoded only admin/settings/6 stock categories, so a fresh prod DB came up empty of the 40 menu items the owner added through admin UI in preview. Fix (verified): seed.py now loads /app/backend/seed_data/*.json (menu_items, categories, sauces, burger_* collections) and does an id/slug match idempotent insert on every startup — empty DBs auto-populate, existing DBs are untouched. Verified against fresh DB (all counts correct) and second run (no duplicates).
